create_pipeline.description: Create a pipeline from a declaration - for example a copy of another pipeline's, from Get pipeline. AWS starts its first run straight away. The service role and the S3 artifact bucket must already exist in this region.
create_pipeline.name: create_pipeline

parameters.description: The pipeline declaration as JSON: name, roleArn, artifactStore and stages, in AWS's own format. The easiest source is the 'pipeline' field of Get pipeline.
parameters.name: pipeline

parameters.description: A name for the new pipeline, overriding the declaration's. Letters, digits and . @ - _ only.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: V2 supports variables, triggers, rollback and the queued and parallel modes. Leave empty for V2 unless the declaration says otherwise.
parameters.name: pipeline_type

parameters.description: How runs that overlap are handled. Leave empty to keep the declaration's.
parameters.name: execution_mode

options.label: Superseded - a newer run replaces a waiting one
Parallel - runs never wait for each other (V2)

parameters.description: Tags for the pipeline, as key: value.
parameters.name: tags

artifact_store_location.description: The S3 bucket that holds its artifacts.

created.description: When it was created (Get pipeline only).

pipeline.description: The full declaration in AWS's own format - edit it and pass it to Update pipeline, or to Create pipeline to copy the pipeline.

polling_disabled_at.description: When AWS turned off source polling, if it has.

role_arn.description: The service role CodePipeline runs as.

updated.description: When it was last changed (Get pipeline only).

version.description: Its version; each update adds one.

delete_pipeline.description: Delete a pipeline. There is no undo; its artifacts in S3 are left in place.
delete_pipeline.name: delete_pipeline

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

deleted.description: Always true - AWS returns an empty body on success.

disable_stage_transition.description: Hold executions before (Inbound) or after (Outbound) a stage until the transition is enabled again.
disable_stage_transition.name: disable_stage_transition

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Pick one of the pipeline's stages (names are case-sensitive).
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.description: Which side of the stage: into it, or out of it.
parameters.name: transition_type

parameters.description: Why, shown in the console (up to 300 characters). Letters, digits, spaces and ! @ ( ) . * ? - only - no commas, colons or apostrophes.
parameters.name: reason

enable_stage_transition.description: Let executions flow into or out of a stage again.
enable_stage_transition.name: enable_stage_transition

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Pick one of the pipeline's stages (names are case-sensitive).
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.description: Which side of the stage: into it, or out of it.
parameters.name: transition_type

get_pipeline.description: Read a pipeline's structure - its stages, actions, role and artifact store - plus its ARN. The 'pipeline' field can be edited and passed to Update pipeline.
get_pipeline.name: get_pipeline

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: An earlier version to read. Leave empty for the current one.
parameters.name: version

artifact_store_location.description: The S3 bucket that holds its artifacts.

created.description: When it was created (Get pipeline only).

pipeline.description: The full declaration in AWS's own format - edit it and pass it to Update pipeline, or to Create pipeline to copy the pipeline.

polling_disabled_at.description: When AWS turned off source polling, if it has.

role_arn.description: The service role CodePipeline runs as.

updated.description: When it was last changed (Get pipeline only).

version.description: Its version; each update adds one.

get_pipeline_execution.description: Read one execution's status, trigger, source revisions and variables. Optionally wait (up to two minutes) for it to finish.
get_pipeline_execution.name: get_pipeline_execution

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: The execution's id, from Start pipeline execution or List pipeline executions.
parameters.name: pipeline_execution_id

parameters.description: Wait up to this many seconds (0-120). Leave empty not to wait.
parameters.name: wait_seconds

rollback_target_pipeline_execution_id.description: For a rollback: the execution it rolled back to.

status.description: Cancelled, InProgress, Stopped, Stopping, Succeeded, Superseded or Failed.

trigger_type.description: What started it, e.g. StartPipelineExecution or Webhook.

variables.description: Pipeline variables as name: resolved value.

get_pipeline_state.description: Read the live status of every stage and action, which transitions are disabled, and any manual approvals waiting.
get_pipeline_state.display_str_template: Get the state of CodePipeline pipeline {0}
get_pipeline_state.name: get_pipeline_state

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

entity_url.description: A link to the action's resource.

external_execution_id.description: The id of the run in the service doing the work.

token.description: For a waiting approval: the token Approve or reject uses.

inbound_execution_ids.description: Executions waiting to enter the stage.

inbound_transition_enabled.description: False when runs are held before this stage.

status.description: Latest run: Cancelled, InProgress, Failed, Stopped, Stopping, Succeeded or Skipped.

list_action_executions.description: List each action's runs in a pipeline - inputs, outputs, errors and log links - optionally for one execution.
list_action_executions.name: list_action_executions

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Only this execution's action runs. Leave empty for all.

parameters.description: At most this many per page (1-100).
parameters.name: max_results

external_execution_id.description: The run's id in the service doing the work. For an approval in PARALLEL mode, this is its approval token.

provider.description: For example S3, CodeBuild or Manual.

has_more.description: True when there is another page; pass next_token to read it.

next_token.description: Pass to the same action's Next token field to read the next page.

list_action_types.description: List the action providers a pipeline can use (S3, CodeBuild, Manual ...) with the configuration keys each takes.
list_action_types.name: list_action_types

parameters.description: Only action types available in this region, e.g. us-west-2. Leave empty for the connected region.
parameters.name: region_filter

parameters.description: The 'next_token' from a previous page, to read the next one.

configuration_properties.description: The configuration keys the action takes.

has_more.description: True when there is another page; pass next_token to read it.

parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Only executions that succeeded in this stage (V2; useful to find a rollback target).
parameters.name: succeeded_in_stage

parameters.description: At most this many per page (1-100).
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description: The 'next_token' from a previous page, to read the next one.
parameters.name: next_token

rollback_target_pipeline_execution_id.description: For a rollback: the execution it rolled back to.

stop_reason.description: The reason given when it was stopped.

has_more.description: True when there is another page; pass next_token to read it.

next_token.description: Pass to the same action's Next token field to read the next page.

list_pipelines.description: List the pipelines in the connected region.

put_approval_result.description: Approve or reject a manual approval that is waiting. The approval token is looked up for you; set 'Wait up to' to wait for a run to reach the approval.
put_approval_result.display_str_template: Approve or reject in CodePipeline pipeline {0}
put_approval_result.name: put_approval_result

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Pick one of the pipeline's stages (names are case-sensitive).
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.description: The manual approval action in that stage.
parameters.name: action_name

parameters.description: Approve, or reject (which fails the stage).
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: A comment recorded with the decision (up to 512 characters).
parameters.name: summary

parameters.description: Leave empty to use the approval waiting now. Only needed in PARALLEL mode: the approval's external execution id from List action executions.
parameters.name: token

parameters.description: Wait up to this many seconds (0-120). Leave empty not to wait.
parameters.name: wait_seconds

retry_stage_execution.description: Re-run a stage whose latest run failed, without starting the pipeline again.
retry_stage_execution.display_str_template: Retry a stage of CodePipeline pipeline {0}
retry_stage_execution.name: retry_stage_execution

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Pick one of the pipeline's stages (names are case-sensitive).
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.description: Re-run only the failed actions, or the whole stage. A rejected manual approval is only retryable with 'Every action in the stage'.
parameters.name: retry_mode

parameters.description: The stage's execution to retry. Leave empty for its latest one - the only one AWS lets you retry.
parameters.name: pipeline_execution_id

rollback_stage.description: Re-run a stage with the artifacts of an earlier execution that succeeded in it (V2 pipelines; not source stages). List pipeline executions with 'Succeeded in stage' finds one.
rollback_stage.display_str_template: Roll back a stage of CodePipeline pipeline {0}
rollback_stage.name: rollback_stage

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Pick one of the pipeline's stages (names are case-sensitive).
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.description: The earlier execution to roll back to. It must have succeeded in this stage on the current pipeline version.
parameters.name: target_pipeline_execution_id

start_pipeline_execution.description: Run a pipeline with the latest source, or with a pinned source revision. Variables and pinned revisions need a V2 pipeline.
start_pipeline_execution.name: start_pipeline_execution

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: Values for the pipeline's variables, as name: value (V2 only). Values cannot be empty.
parameters.name: variables

parameters.description: To pin a revision: the source action to pin, for example 'Source'.
parameters.name: source_action_name

parameters.description: To pin a revision: what kind of revision it is.
parameters.name: revision_type

parameters.description: To pin a revision: the commit id, digest or S3 value.
parameters.name: revision_value

parameters.description: Optional: a unique value (letters, digits, '-') so a retried step does not start a second run.
parameters.name: client_request_token

stop_pipeline_execution.description: Stop a running execution. By default running actions finish first; Abandon stops at once, which can leave work half done.
stop_pipeline_execution.name: stop_pipeline_execution

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: The execution's id, from Start pipeline execution or List pipeline executions.
parameters.name: pipeline_execution_id

parameters.description: Stop immediately without waiting for running actions. This can lead to failed or out-of-sequence tasks.
parameters.name: abandon

parameters.description: Why it was stopped (up to 200 characters).
parameters.name: reason

tag_resource.description: Add tags to a pipeline. A key it already has gets the new value.
tag_resource.name: tag_resource

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name or paste its ARN.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: The tags to add, as key: value (up to 50).
parameters.name: tags

untag_resource.description: Remove tags from a pipeline by key.
untag_resource.name: untag_resource

parameters.description: Pick a pipeline, or type its name or paste its ARN.
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.description: The tag keys to remove.
parameters.name: tag_keys
